notes.title: The Legacy Demo Patch 1. An opportunity to be reborn. Development Diary #6.
notes.notes: [p]We're excited to announce an important patch for The Legacy Demo![/p][p]Thank you to everyone who leaves feedback on Steam and takes our short survey, we study every feedback in detail and improve the game for you.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3112550/The_Legacy_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109069/add3429a4026677c3fd4b56ad833a3141ae250b8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109069/8afba5b654c5796f956186265725266756aa69c4.png"][/img][/p][p]In this patch some things have been fixed, plus we added some very important things such as: an option to enable/disable the ability to revive after death, a slider to customize background sounds that were too loud in the background, added a lot of useful hints and more![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109069/d03043dc94984734c2421fd4c362c9f66d77d0ec.png"][/img][/p][h3]Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Added a slider to customize ambient sounds; [/p][/*][*][p]Removed headshots to the head from cold weapons, head damage is now ×3;[/p][/*][*][p]Putting on a mask now displays the effect on the screen;[/p][/*][*][p]Added a reset button for filters;[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the user interface of filters - it is now more user-friendly and clearer;[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hint on how to reanimate the player in the “Death” state UI;[/p][/*][*][p]More rocks have been added in the vicinity of Svetlograd;[/p][/*][*][p]More red barrels added to the map;[/p][/*][*][p]Day length increased to 40 minutes;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bugs with hands in night vision mode and underwater effect;[/p][/*][*][p]Added tooltip animation when opening inventory for the first time after picking up a book.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced zombie, player and soldier background artwork in the vault;[/p][/*][*][p]Stove now displays a tooltip on how to fire it up;[/p][/*][*][p]Added in-game revival option;[/p][/*][*][p]Added a tooltip about green smoke defense;[/p][/*][*][p]Cargo loot has been rebalanced;[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory chat became more visible and readable;[/p][/*][*][p]Occasionally the snake would play the sound of a boar - Fixed;[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced vampire and witch health, now they are 10-15% harder to kill;[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few new screemer sounds;[/p][/*][*][p]In the starting control panel - Added information on how to get resources;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bugs in Dutch language.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109069/e5ded95467aeff61b33aab5a677fb7bb02cb6896.png"][/img][/p]
